shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo "---node_modules sample---"; ls /workspace/node_modules | head -30; echo "---"; node -v; npm -v
rm -f data/books.json && (npm run start -- -p 3100 &) ; sleep 3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/

curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "Nothing yet" ; echo "---add book---"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  --data-urlencode "title=Project Hail Mary" \
  --data-urlencode "author=Andy Weir" \
  --data-urlencode "notes=Great science, fun narrator." \
  -o /tmp/resp.html -D /tmp/headers.txt -L
cat /tmp/headers.txt | head -20
echo "---books.json---"
cat data/books.json

ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oP 'ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' | head -1)
echo "action id: $ACTION_ID"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/ \
  -F "\$${ACTION_ID}=" \
  -F "title=Project Hail Mary" \
  -F "author=Andy Weir" \
  -F "notes=Great science, fun narrator." \
  -o /tmp/resp2.html -D /tmp/headers2.txt
head -20 /tmp/headers2.txt
echo "---books.json---"
cat data/books.json

ID="44740bce-12cd-4f9b-b28d-26acb0e3fb37" echo "--- home page ---" curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oE "Project Hail Mary|Andy Weir|Currently reading|Mark finished" echo "--- detail page ---" curl -s http://localhost:3100/books/$ID | grep -oE "

[^<]+

|by [A-Za-z ]+|Great science, fun narrator\.|Currently reading" echo "--- mark finished ---" ACTION_ID2=$(curl -s http://localhost:3100/books/$ID | grep -oP 'ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' | head -1) echo "action id: $ACTION_ID2" curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/books/$ID \ -F "\$${ACTION_ID2}=" \ -F "id=$ID" \ -o /tmp/resp3.html -D /tmp/headers3.txt head -10 /tmp/headers3.txt echo "--- books.json after finish ---" cat data/books.json echo "--- home page after finish ---" curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oE "Currently reading|Finished|Nothing yet|Project Hail Mary"

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
(npm run start -- -p 3100 &) ; sleep 3
echo "--- after restart, home page ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oE "Currently reading|Finished|Nothing yet|Project Hail Mary"
echo "--- unknown book id ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/books/does-not-exist
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null
echo done
pgrep -af "next start" || echo "no next process running"

nohup npm run start -- -p 3100 > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
echo "--- after restart, home page ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oE "Currently reading|Finished|Nothing yet|Project Hail Mary"
echo "--- unknown book id ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/books/does-not-exist

pgrep -af "next-server\|next start" 
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null
pkill -f "npm run start" 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
pgrep -af "next-server\|next start" || echo "stopped"
rm -f /workspace/data/books.json
rmdir /workspace/data 2>/dev/null || true
ls /workspace/data 2>/dev/null || echo "data dir removed (will be recreated on first run)"
